label: incipit-api URL, e.g. http://host:3737 - enables Hardcover, OpenLibrary and duration matching. Blank = Audible only.
Hardcover API token (free at hardcover.app/settings). Blank = skip Hardcover.
Strip a trailing series from author names: "Author (Series)" -> "Author"
Recover the author from the folder path when the artist tag matches nothing (e.g. a narrator tagged as the artist)
Recover the book title from the folder when the album tag is missing or "[Unknown Album]"
Trust a metadata.json sidecar (Audiobookshelf-style) for ASIN/title/author over the file tags. An ASIN gives a definitive match; otherwise its title/author are used for the search.
Use the book folder's cover.jpg as the poster when present. Unchecked: use the matched online cover.
On a metadata refresh, save the current poster to cover.jpg next to the book (only when it changed), so a manually-set cover persists to disk and survives a rebuild.
Development: disable API response caching (slower; leave off for normal use)
